_comment: Profile seeding, and the custom profile that makes editing one something other than a dead end. Three of these guards stand between a config file and an unbootable board: the offset agreement check, its refusal to become a no-op, and the refusal to overwrite answers the user wrote by hand. The seed name whitelist stands between a browser and reading an arbitrary file off the printer. The rest stand between a user and the only copy of their own answers.
